execution_log.note: I added first-class tenant_id storage and tenant-aware SQL filtering for Dagster asset_results, removed request-path database creation from optimization history initialization, and routed both dashboard optimization strategy APIs through tenant-scoped config resolution.

I aligned the optimization strategy endpoints with the tenant-scoping contract used by the protected settings route by requiring trusted override authorization for non-default tenant access, propagating structured TENANT_AUTH_REQUIRED and INVALID_TENANT responses, and mirroring the same guard in the legacy nuxt_dashboard tenant utility and strategy handlers so they no longer trust caller-supplied tenant IDs for shared ML state.
